primaryRawText:
XG650 PLUS PLATINUM
SILENCE IS PLATINUM
The XG Plus Platinum Cooler Master’s first in-house designed
platform. It was created to provide 80 PLUS Platinum certified
efficiency and high-end performance with reduced temperature
requirements. This unit offers full-modular cabling, a 135mm
silent fan, and a 10 years warranty. In addition, 100%
Japanese capacitors have been used in both the platform and
cables for increased efficiency and reduced ripple noise,
ensuring a more stable output for better, more consistent
performance. Monitor performance with the built-in Information
Display Panel and manage these features and ARGB lighting
with Cooler Master's free MasterPlus+ software.
FEATURES SPECIFICATIONS
In-House Platform Design : This is Cooler Master's first in-house
designed PSU platform, built for high-end performance with reduced
temperature requirements.
80 PLUS Platinum Certified : This certification guarantees a minimum
typical efficiency of 92% under normal operating conditions.
Quiet ARGB 135mm silent Fan : The fluid dynamic fan bearing creates
less friction, delivering quiet cooling performance.
Information Display Panel : Built-in ARGB display panel shows
temperature, fan speed, and power consumption.
Full-Modular Flat Cabling with In-unit Capacitor : Reduces ripple
noise, increase airflow, and improve overall efficiency and thermal
performance.
10-Year Warranty : 10-year warranty for core operating
products, 3-year warranty for ARGB LED. This unit comes with
a standard limited manufacturing warranty from the date of
purchase.
